deals.headline: McKenna estate sells 2.35% of the Bears at an $8.9bn valuation
deals.summary: The estate of Andrew McKenna Sr. sold a 2.35% stake to the existing owners, the McCaskey and Ryan families, at a price valuing the franchise at $8.9bn, a record for an NFL minority stake; Galatioto Sports Partners ran the sale.

ownership_summary: Controlled by the McCaskey family, heirs of founder George Halas; Virginia Halas McCaskey, principal owner since 1983, died in February 2025 and her son George McCaskey is chairman. The Ryan family (Pat Ryan) holds the main minority stake, bought with Andrew McKenna in 1990; in September 2025 the McKenna estate sold its 2.35% to the McCaskey and Ryan families at an $8.9bn valuation. No institutional fund holds a stake.
